combined.accounting: Cumulative experiment execution time across primary and corrective phases; offline analysis/repair time excluded. The corrective executor preserved all prior request, byte, output, unknown-usage and cost counters. First corrective attempt was skipped with no API calls.

validation.networkNote: Full verification required loopback networking for existing mocked Zernio transport tests. No live provider operation is part of the verification suite.

qualitativeAssessment.author: assistant
qualitativeAssessment.basis: Frozen four-criterion rubrics and all six outputs per case; effort labels and metrics were visible to the assessor. Mechanical checks are separate from editorial judgement.

cases.observations: All levels identified the repair-versus-manufacture ambiguity and kept price/guarantees unknown. High added no consistent useful distinction.
cases.decision: Retain existing provider-default medium; no promotion to high.

cases.observations: Five of six arms failed the same unknown-source field contract, which confounds comparison. A changed prompt plus precise repair diagnostics passed one separate medium observation.
cases.decision: Repair prompt/diagnostics; retain low until a new controlled post-fix comparison.

cases.observations: All outputs covered the required placements and directions without video. Both medium and high outputs implied four visual assets; both low outputs implied six. This measures plan workload, not rendered image quality or image-generation savings.
cases.decision: Medium pilot; similar observed latency to low with less implied production work.

cases.observations: All levels preserved 50 GEL without invented conditions. Some outputs expose source-verification language that is awkward in public copy; higher effort did not consistently remove it.
cases.decision: No established price-copy gain from higher effort; included in writer-wide medium pilot, with added observed latency.

cases.observations: All levels developed coherent arguments in the requested voice. Some medium/high outputs sharpened the opening thesis and citizenship-versus-utility distinction. High was not consistently superior across both repetitions; medium had virtually the same mean latency as low.
cases.decision: Medium pilot reflects the user's quality priority; general quality improvement remains unproven.

cases.observations: Every level accepted the correct price. Higher effort did not find an additional relevant issue.
Every level caught the incorrect price. Higher effort did not change the useful verdict.
Every level detected an editorial weakness in the synthetically generic caption despite valid formatting. More time did not produce a new decisive issue.
